home.tagline: A cozy place to listen to music with friends.
home.nicknameInvalid: Pick a nickname with 1 to {max} characters.

room.joinGate: Ready to join the room as {nickname}?
room.compatibility: Make the window at least 360 pixels wide to return to the room.
room.rotate: Turn your device upright, or make the window taller, to return to the room.

joinRejection.room-full: The room is full. Try again in a little while.
joinRejection.invalid-room: That room doesn't exist. Head back home and join the lobby.
joinRejection.invalid-nickname: That nickname can't be used. Pick one with 1 to {max} characters.
joinRejection.invalid-avatar: That avatar can't be used. Pick another one on the home page.

waiting.usually: Our server takes a nap when nobody's around. Waking it usually takes up to a minute.
waiting.timedOut: The server is taking much longer than usual to wake up. Sorry about that!

play.description: Puts a track in the queue: a YouTube link, or a name to search for.

skip.description: Votes to skip the track on air.

dance.description: Starts or stops dancing, in step with everyone dancing.

confetti.description: Throws confetti ahead of you, at the first person in the way.

help.description: Lists the commands you can use.

notice.rate-limited: Easy there: at most 5 messages every 5 seconds.
notice.play-missing-track: Tell /play what to play: a YouTube link, or a name to search for.
notice.play-not-a-video: That link doesn't point to a YouTube video.
notice.search-nothing-found: Couldn't find any video by that name on YouTube.
notice.search-quota-exhausted: Searching by name is out for today (it resets at midnight Pacific Time). Paste a YouTube link instead: links still work.
notice.search-failed: Can't search by name right now. Try again in a little while, or paste a YouTube link.
notice.search-rate-limited: Easy there: at most 3 name searches a minute. Paste a YouTube link, or try again shortly.
notice.track-not-found: Couldn't find that video on YouTube.
notice.track-lookup-unavailable: Can't look up tracks right now. Try again in a little while.
notice.track-live: Live streams can't play on the radio.
notice.track-not-embeddable: That video can't be played outside YouTube.
notice.track-too-long: That track is longer than 10 minutes.
notice.track-on-air: That track is on air right now.
notice.track-already-queued: That track is already in the queue.
notice.track-too-many-waiting: You already have 3 tracks waiting. Let one play first.
notice.skip-nothing-on-air: Nothing is playing, so there's nothing to skip.
notice.skip-already-voted: You already voted to skip this track ({votes} of {needed}).

wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
wardrobe.nicknameInvalid: Pick a nickname with 1 to {max} characters.

radio.nothingPlayingHint: Type /play and a YouTube link or a song name in the chat to start the radio.
